# Getting help

* **Questions and setup help:** ask in [Discord](https://discord.gg/kKQd6PJe22).
* **Something is broken:** open a [bug report](https://github.com/TasfiqSami/TasfiqUnloader/issues/new/choose) with your
  server software and version, Java version, `config.yml` and the relevant log lines.
* **Idea for a feature:** open a [feature request](https://github.com/TasfiqSami/TasfiqUnloader/issues/new/choose).
* **Security problem:** see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

Before asking, check the [README](../README.md): the config options, commands and known caveats are documented there.
